stages.description: In declaration order; the dependency order comes from `needs` and `after`.

PipelineDefinition.description: sentinel-pipeline/draft-1 — `.farsight/sentinel/pipeline.json`. Adopted by digest like the settings: its place in a checkout does not make it trusted, and a changed byte (its own or a referenced pack's) is a new revision.

Id.description: A ledger identifier. Opaque, bounded and free of path separators and whitespace.

Ordinal.description: A positive integer ordinal or revision.

needs.description: Typed inputs. A missing required input, a cycle or an incompatible type refuses the pipeline before anything runs.

after.description: Ordering only: these stages finish first, and nothing of theirs is read.

required.description: A required stage that does not complete leaves required coverage incomplete. Only `builtin` and `tool` make coverage.

BuiltinStageDefinition.description: A stage implemented by Sentinel's own code, in-process or as a bounded child.

StageId.description: A stage id: a built-in plan stage (`capture`, `review-guided`) or one a pipeline declares (`secrets`, `triage`). Lower-case words joined by single hyphens, so it never collides with a context input, which carries a dot.

StageInputDecl.description: A typed input: every output of a stage (by its id), one named output of a stage, or graph context.

ContextInputId.description: Context the application graph supplies (`farsight.journeys`): pinned Farsight data, never live disk.

StageOutputRef.description: One named output of an upstream stage. It resolves to exact artifact ids when the producer publishes.

StageOutputName.description: The name one stage's output is wired by (`findings`, `walkthrough`, `triage`).

StageOutputDecl.description: A typed output a stage declares: one Sentinel knows, or a named custom one.

StageOutputType.description: The typed outputs Sentinel itself knows how to read. A custom output names a schema instead.

NamedStageOutput.description: A custom typed output: its name for wiring and the schema its bytes must validate against.

OutputSchemaId.description: A custom output's schema id, `<area>.<name>/v<n>` (`sentinel.triage/v1`). Sentinel validates the stage's output against it after the stage exits; a failed validation is a failed attempt, never a partial publication.

StageFanOut.description: How many units a stage becomes: one per run, per captured source, per entry point or per planned check.

tokens.description: Tokens in and out together, per unit.

usd.description: A monetary ceiling in US dollars, written as a decimal string so it is never a binary float.

StageBudget.description: Bounds on one stage. Each is a ceiling the policy may lower; none is a grant.

DecimalAmount.description: A non-negative decimal amount written as a string, so money is never a binary float.

BuiltinOperation.description: What a `builtin` stage runs: Sentinel's own capture, parse and inventory, the bounded call paths under each entry point (`walkthrough`, today's `analysis/paths`), the framework control facts, and the report.

needs.description: Typed inputs. A missing required input, a cycle or an incompatible type refuses the pipeline before anything runs.

after.description: Ordering only: these stages finish first, and nothing of theirs is read.

required.description: A required stage that does not complete leaves required coverage incomplete. Only `builtin` and `tool` make coverage.

adapter.description: A registered scanner adapter (`gitleaks`, `semgrep`); availability is checked against the registry.

rules.description: The rule families it runs, or one whole promoted pack. Only locked rules are planned.

ToolStageDefinition.description: A scanner adapter in a pinned Linux container, never pulled during a scan, with no host fallback.

RuleFamilyList.description: Rule families a tool stage runs, by id.

RuleFamilyId.description: A stable rule family: `sentinel.<area>.<name>` for original rules, `<vendor>.<area>.<name>` otherwise.

RulePackSelector.description: A whole promoted rule pack a tool stage selects, `pack:<origin>:<name>` (`pack:builtin:pattern`).

needs.description: Typed inputs. A missing required input, a cycle or an incompatible type refuses the pipeline before anything runs.

after.description: Ordering only: these stages finish first, and nothing of theirs is read.

required.description: A required stage that does not complete leaves required coverage incomplete. Only `builtin` and `tool` make coverage.

runner.description: `host` is the weaker isolation class and is named so in the report.

ScriptStageDefinition.description: An entry file from a promoted stage pack, run on the host (behind `stage.host-scripts`) or in a pinned container.

PackRef.description: A file inside a promoted stage pack, `stages/<id>@<revision>#<file>`, or a whole skill pack, `skills/<id>@<revision>`. The pipeline's digest covers the referenced bytes, so a changed prompt is a new pipeline.

ScriptArgument.description: One argument passed to a script, as written. Never a credential: settings and pipelines hold none.

needs.description: Typed inputs. A missing required input, a cycle or an incompatible type refuses the pipeline before anything runs.

after.description: Ordering only: these stages finish first, and nothing of theirs is read.

required.description: A required stage that does not complete leaves required coverage incomplete. Only `builtin` and `tool` make coverage.

provider.description: The adopted settings provider entry to bind; absent when the runner has exactly one adopted provider.

prompt.description: The prompt a brokered stage sends.

instructions.description: The instructions a native stage's CLI reads.

skills.description: Skill packs, in order: the order is part of the instruction bytes.

AgentStageDefinition.description: A model stage. It proposes cited claims; it can never make coverage.

AgentMode.description: `brokered`: Sentinel runs the loop and the evidence broker serves cited slices. `native`: the CLI runs its own loop over a scratch tree holding only the stage's declared inputs, and its full transcript is retained.

AgentRunnerId.description: The agent runners a stage may name: the two CLIs, a hosted model API (off unless `review.hosted-api` is on), and a local model server (an adopted `ollama` provider that keeps the source on this machine).

ModelName.description: A model name as the provider spells it.

PipelineFlags.description: The features a pipeline needs, by registry name. `true` asks for the feature: a stage that needs a feature the adopted settings leave off is refused at plan, with the feature named. A request never turns anything on.
